content.rendered: Come join us for a night of FUN and DANCING!  Middleton’s Annual Horseshoe Hop is coming up on Friday, February 8th 6:00-7:30 pm. in our gym.  This FREE family event is always a lot of fun; it gives students and their families a chance to dance and socialize with neighbors and friends.  Just a friendly reminder:  all students, regardless of grade level, need be accompanied by an adult to ensure that we are creating a safe environment where everyone can relax and have fun.  We will have gluten free, cheese and pepperoni pizza available to buy for $1 per slice.  Exact change would be greatly appreciated.  To add to the fun there will also be a professional photo booth to capture the good times.  If you would like to help organize this fun event, or volunteer the day of the dance, reach out to Gia Waugh at middletonpacpres@gmail.com. .   Please feel free to bring a non-perishable item to help support our food drive. Anything is appreciated.
